claims.claimText: CUIMC maintains an official AI Tools × Data Classification matrix governing use with Sensitive Data (PHI, PII, RHI) versus Confidential/Internal and Public data; availability through central CUIT does not constitute approval for Sensitive Data under HIPAA.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: You may notice a tool is available University-wide through CUIT but not approved for Sensitive Data at CUIMC. The reason is HIPAA. CUIMC operates as part of a HIPAA covered entity. Much of the data here is PHI/RHI, so a tool is only approved for Sensitive Data when Columbia has a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) or equivalent contractual protections in place and the tool is configured to keep data inside the protected CUIMC environment... Bottom line: availability ≠ approval for Sensitive Data.
